content: Kelekele rârâni ikeno samba ilo wa tâno kulu wa sipanea Maro Kindeni sisuka i ŋa kâki
Tapanea Yova Kindeni ŋa tasuka kâki! Miki rârâni kamo samba ilo, mikini kala kamo âta ŋinde, ande miki kapanea Yova Kindeni ŋa kasuka kâki!
Miki aŋelo rârâni, miki kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki! Mao nâ, miki aŋelo kaika rârâni, miki kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki mine nâ!
Kari wa nzimona wa, miki kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki! Aŋga miki pitu rârâni uru kasinala nia, miki kala kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki mine nâ!
Noko samba kumo âta ndo, noko kupanea i ŋa kusuka kâki! Aŋga miki lââ kamo âta ŋinde, ande miki kala kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki mine nâ!
Ara ŋana kelekele rârâni ŋinde ma sipanea Yova Kindeni sisuka i ŋa kâki, ŋana tu nia ndoyo i tamwata iporo itu ŋgua kaika, aku kinzi sipâŋga kala simo.
Ina iporo ŋgua, kala kinzi silâ simo nianzi nianzi, ma simo mine ku simo nâ. Io keri panzi lâ, aku sâ toŋge ikura tu itoto i ne ŋgua tukuŋa ŋinde ututu, ande tia ndo.
Aŋga miki kelekele rârâni kamo tâno kulu, miki kala kapanea Yova Kindeni ŋa kasuka kâki! Miki iŋa ŋalaŋala wa kelekele kamo tâi geza-geza wa,
miki karâzi ne loloa wa mira “ais” wa, miki wââ wa mwâka wa, miki mbilu-lawea kaika kala uru kapono muli pa Yova Kindeni kawa ŋgua, ande miki rârâni kapanea i ŋa kasuka kâki!
Miki tuu ŋalaŋala wa tuu kiri-kiri wa, miki kâi bâŋa wa kâi kamandi dugu ilo wa,
miki simbi bâŋa wa simbi ŋgoi wa, miki mwâta wa sii wa, ande miki kala kapanea Yova Kindeni ŋa kasuka kâki!
Aŋga miki koipu ŋalaŋala wa miki tamâta ŋgu ndoni wa, miki tamâta mbâna-mbâna wa miki katonâŋa rârâni wa,
miki tamâta limoa wa miki taine taipa wa, miki tamâta kokoŋa wa miki lâlu kiri-kiri wa, ande miki rârâni kala kapanea Yova Kindeni ŋa kasuka kâki!

Mao kanaŋo, miki rârâni kapanea Yova Kindeni ŋa kasuka kâki, ŋana tu i simbo nâ ŋa nde ŋalae, ipolenzi ŋoa ŋalaŋala pinde rârâni. I ne walo nde kaika ndo, aku kelekele rârâni simo samba ilo wa tâno kulu wa, ande kelekele rârâni ŋinde simo i kalo nâ.
Aku i tini mwasa ndo panzi Isrel tamâta, kala ivetanzi sipâŋga ŋgu kaika lâ. Kinzi simo i tamwata ne tamâta. Mine kala kinzi uru sipanea i ŋa sisuka kâki. Tapanea Yova Kindeni ŋa tasuka kâki!
